scope: simulation only; no robot; no formal training
poses: front/back x all 7 reference keyframes; 28 envs give 2 initial replicas per stratum

profiles.quiet: published terrain/noise/PD, external kicks and pushes set to zero
profiles.stress: external perturbations x1.5 and initial torso sigma 0.2; exploratory
profiles.hold: published perturbations; suppress reference-complete reset only to measure continued standing
profiles.stress_sustained: Additional exploratory run before any such results: same 1.5x/torso-sigma-0.2 stress recipe, but submit body force in EVERY physics step (public submits once per ten substeps). Record separately, not a public-recipe pass/fail.

merge_gates.numerical: all state/action finite; all applied torques within URDF clamp; reset-input error <=1e-5
merge_gates.initialization_and_commands: requested reset q and held/commanded targets within URDF limits <=1e-6
merge_gates.physical_joint_limits: max sampled physical overshoot <=0.05 rad; continuous >0.01 rad excursion <=0.10 s; engineering simulation gate, not a robot safety certification
merge_gates.nominal_quality: quiet reference completion >=95% overall and >=90% per completed posture stratum
merge_gates.published_quality: reference completion >=90% overall and >=80% per posture stratum; terminal stable-stance check recorded separately
merge_gates.hold: Report failures and post-getup upright coverage separately. This prolongs the getup actor beyond production phase transition, so it cannot certify the production getup-to-walk handoff. Primary merge gates remain numerical, initialization/targets, physical joint limits, quiet and published posture completion.
merge_gates.stress: characterization only; failures cannot be presented as passing published conditions

stance_check: root relative terrain >=0.45 m, |roll| and |pitch| <=0.35 rad, linear speed <=0.5 m/s, angular speed <=1.5 rad/s, continuously >=0.2 s
rule: Do not loosen termination/reward or widen gates to get a pass. If quality gates fail, retain candidate and block unconditional mainline promotion.

hold_gate_revision_before_first_hold_run.reason: Production GetUpPhase::createNextPhase forces a walking phase (GetUpEngine.cpp:542-547); holding the getup actor for 120 s exceeds its production motion contract. Retain the predeclared hold criterion as an exploratory pass/fail, not a substitute for testing the getup-to-walk handoff. No hold results exist yet.

hold_characterization_criterion: Before first hold run: no episode termination through whole window, post-getup upright coverage >=95% overall and >=90% for every environment; record partial initial episode exposure.
